question: ΔABC ∼ ΔEDF and area (ΔABC) :area (ΔEDF) = 1 : 4. If AB = 7 cm, BC = 8 cm and CA = 9 cm, then DF is equal to:
solution:
Given:

ΔABC ~ ΔEDF,

AB = 7 cm,

BC = 8 cm,

CA = 9 cm and ar(ΔABC) ∶ ar(ΔEDF) = 1/4

Concept used:

When two triangles are similar then the ratio of their area is equal to the ratio of the square of their corresponding sides.

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0df3b63479120d0d57777f27ffa5fb4a4acf4a147c7a83e6ede12cd14fc8f64a.png] 

As we know,

ar(ΔABC) / ar(ΔEDF) = (BC/DF)2 (As the triangles are similar)

⇒ 1/4 = 82/DF2 

⇒ DF2 = 82 × 4

⇒ DF = 8 × 2 = 16 cm 

∴ DF is equal to 16 cm.
